products.name: Camera Lens (pre-cut)
products.notes: hand-verified threshold mask, NOT a hand-drawn annotation: background distance + Otsu + morphology, then inspected at 1:1 along the boundary. Derived from camera_lens, so treat the two as one item when sampling. Gives an extraction-error-free reference for attributing fidelity loss to compositing.

products.name: Blue Sunglasses (pre-cut)
products.notes: synthetic pre-cut input: the Stage 2 cut-out of sunglasses_blue saved as alpha, so Stage 2 reads the mask back exactly and adds no error. Isolates compositing loss and carries no information about matting accuracy. Derived from sunglasses_blue; sample the two as one item.
